vertex_layout: pos f32x3 | normal snorm8x4 | uv unorm16x2 | joints u8x4 | weights unorm8x4 (sum 255) | material u8, flags u8, pad x2
index_layout: u16 when nv < 65536 else u32, triangle list, counter-clockwise outward
delta_layout: int16 x (keys x nv x 3), key order lean, stocky, narrow, broad; metres = int16 * delta_scale_m; position = base + sum(w_k * delta_k) with the instance shape (build, chest) mapped to the four keys
bodies: body_shape 0..11 = build index * 3 + chest index; builds [-1,-0.35,0.35,1], chests [-1,0,1]
